headline: IDF announces killing of 4 Hamas operatives in Saturday Gaza strikes, including Nukhba member who infiltrated Nir Oz on Oct 7
dek: The IDF announced Monday it killed four Hamas military-wing operatives in strikes across Gaza on Saturday: in Khan Younis, Nukhba member Muhammad Kamel Masleh Qadih, who infiltrated Kibbutz Nir Oz on Oct 7, 2023 and oversaw Nukhba preparation/training; in Nuseirat, Nukhba member Diaa Abd al-Mohsen…
sources: IDF announcement, via The Jerusalem Post
fault_line: Targeted counter-terrorism against Oct 7 attackers, or more ceasefire violations -- do Saturday's killings prove the Gaza ceasefire is already dead?

sections.what_happened: The IDF announced Monday it killed four Hamas military-wing operatives in strikes across Gaza on Saturday: in Khan Younis, Nukhba member Muhammad Kamel Masleh Qadih, who infiltrated Kibbutz Nir Oz on Oct 7, 2023 and oversaw Nukhba preparation/training; in Nuseirat, Nukhba member Diaa Abd al-Mohsen Muhammad Abu al-Rous; in northern Gaza, Nabil Hamad (senior Hamas military recruitment figure) and Mohannad Nader Mahmoud Dahdouh (sniper commander). The IDF also announced two further operatives killed Oct 22, one of them Wael Naif Fahmi Muslim, another Nukhba member involved in the 2023 infiltration. Distinct from Monday's reported 4 civilian deaths in Gaza (1400-01) -- these are Saturday strikes announced Monday, not a new Monday strike.
sections.what_verified: Jerusalem Post report of the IDF announcement only.
sections.what_disputed: No independent or Palestinian-source confirmation in-window; Hamas has not commented in the surfaced reporting. The announcement arrives amid the ongoing ceasefire-violation pattern (1,583 killed since Oct 10, 2025 per Gaza Health Ministry, recorded 1400-01) -- the IDF frames these as targeted counter-terrorism; the toll pattern frames them as ceasefire violations. Both framings must be carried.
sections.why_matters: ISRAEL SAYS IT KILLED THE NIR OZ INFILTRATOR -- ON SATURDAY, ANNOUNCED MONDAY: one of the four named dead is a Nukhba man the IDF says entered Nir Oz on Oct 7. Carry the IDF attribution hard and the 1,583 ceasefire-period toll alongside it; do not merge these Saturday deaths with Monday's 4 civilian deaths.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (Jerusalem Post Nov 2 12:32 IST = 14:32 ) -- IDF announces killing of 4 Hamas operatives in Saturday Gaza strikes, including Nukhba member who infiltrated Nir Oz on Oct 7, 2023
